text:
sophie: quick async status check for Halcyon-13B (open). owners are @lina (ML) + @cam (serving). target catalog launch next Tue (2026-03-24). main asks: licensing ok? perf profile ready? quant plan? canary/rollback plan? any blockers?

lina: pinged. I have perf runs but need a validation eval set from prod prompts. will share numbers by EOD. quant plan: prefer 4-bit q8x4+KV-cache, leaning on our new q4x4 profile.

cam: serving side: can host on Dedicated pool, need confirmation on max_seq and batch targets. can run canary at 20 qps with burst to 100. building a minimal route in canary config now.

rahul: legal here — halcyon license is Apache-2.0 variant with a non-commercial clause in the model weights repo. need the exact repo link and license text to clear. if repo is the one Lina shared earlier, we'll need an approved exceptions doc for enterprise customers.

sophie: @rahul repo link: https://github.com/halcyon-ai/halcyon-13b-model (from intake). Lina, can you confirm it's the exact artifact and copy the license text here?

lina: yes that's it. license snippet: "Apache-2.0 with non-commercial addendum v1". pasting full file in a gist in a sec. note: tokenizer files in a separate repo (halcyon-tokenizer) under MIT.

rahul: ok — that non-commercial clause is a blocker for Enterprise Managed & Dedicated by default. two options: (1) get model owner to remove the clause, or (2) we onboard as community-only (hosted API no-commit) and flag enterprise customers. which route do we want?

cam: ops implications: if (2), we need to prevent Dedicated pools from scheduling halcyon routes. small config change but needs rollout in routing rules.

sophie: prefer (1) if possible. Lina, can you ask upstream about removing clause? If not, we'll proceed with (2) and mark the catalog entry accordingly.

lina: will ask now and update. on perf: quick summary from local runs (seq=2048, bs=1):
```
latency p95: 312ms token gen (gpt-style streaming enabled)
throughput: ~18 tok/s per GPU
mem: ~22GB per shard (8-bit quant)
```
I'm running end-to-end eval against 500-prod prompts — will push numbers + small BLEU/ROUGE set by EOD.

cam: serving test command I ran (for ops):
```
./run_inference --model halcyon-13b --quant q4x4 --max-seq 2048 --bs 1 --warmups 5
```
output looked stable, no OOMs on 48G A10.

kevin: FYI infra capacity: we have two spare NVMe-backed Dedicated nodes in us-west ready for canary. need a tag to reserve.

ops-bot: deploy-checker: Canaries require: model_card, license_text, perf_profile attached to catalog entry. Missing: license_text (currently flagged), perf_profile (pending).

sophie: action items: Lina -> confirm license change request + push eval numbers (owner). Cam -> prepare canary route + gating flag to block Dedicated if license not cleared (serving). Rahul -> outline enterprise exception path if upstream cannot change license (legal). Kevin -> hold nodes if needed (infra). I'll compile a short gating checklist and post to the launch doc.

lina: noted. I'll update thread when I hear back from upstream or have eval artifacts.

cam: tagging @lina for perf artifacts location so I can attach to catalog entry: upload path?

lina: uploading to s3: s3://redwood-model-artifacts/halcyon-13b/insta-evals/1961122337/ — will set ACL to infra-team-read.

rahul: if upstream refuses license change, we can still onboard with a "community only" flag and a modal warning on enterprise flows. I'll draft wording if needed.

sophie: perfect. thanks everyone. if no major surprises, I'll mark this green in the launch doc tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
